`fast-parse` is pinned at `1.4.2` in `package.json`, and `NOTES.md` says that exact version was yanked by the publisher over a prototype-pollution report — `1.4.3` is the fix, and it was never applied.

`AUDIT.md` is written with all four findings, ranked by severity:

1. **`src/routes/internal.js`** — no auth at all on `/internal/metrics` and `/internal/flush-cache`, left exposed after the VPN in front of them was retired.
2. **`src/repo/report.js`** — SQL injection in `runSavedReport` via string-concatenated filter and order fields.
3. **`config/staging.js`** — a real database password committed in plaintext.
4. **`package.json`** — `fast-parse` still on the yanked `1.4.2`, fix is `1.4.3`.

No service code was touched — just the new `AUDIT.md`.
